subject: Spark and Glimmer back through the end of the week.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Spark and Glimmer back through the end of the week.
parts:
A few individuals had missed the emails we sent out and apparently didn't get all their content off of the spark and glimmer.  If you had an account on those servers, you can access the IDE by logging into:

http://oldspark.rstudio.com:8787

and 

http://oldglimmer.rstudio.com:8787

Please share this information with anyone else you know who missed the deadline last time around.  

We will shutdown the servers for good first thing on Monday morning (ET) the 15th of June 

Best,
Tareef

Best wishes,
Jerzy
